products.name: Syltherine
products.description: A slim, sculpted cafe chair that brings comfort and character to any small dining corner.
descriptionParagraphs: Syltherine pairs a lightweight bent frame with a curved backrest, so it's easy to carry from the kitchen table to the balcony without losing its shape.
Each chair is finished by hand, giving the surface a soft, matte texture that feels warm to the touch and pairs well with both wood and metal tables.
products.material: Molded plastic seat, powder-coated steel legs

products.name: Leviosa
products.description: A softer, rounder companion to Syltherine, built for long conversations over coffee.
descriptionParagraphs: Leviosa keeps the same light frame as its sibling chair but trades sharp lines for a gently curved seat that cradles you as you sit.
It stacks neatly against a wall when you need the floor space back, making it a practical pick for smaller cafes and apartments.
products.material: Molded plastic seat, powder-coated steel legs

products.name: Lolito
products.description: An oversized sofa built for sinking in, with deep cushions and a tufted back.
descriptionParagraphs: Lolito is sized for a real living room centerpiece — wide enough for an afternoon nap, deep enough that your feet won't touch the floor from the middle seat.
Underneath the tufted upholstery sits a hardwood frame and high-density foam, so the shape holds up through years of movie nights.
products.material: Solid wood frame, tufted fabric upholstery

products.name: Respira
products.alt: Respira outdoor bar table and stool
products.description: A compact bar-height table and stool set made for balconies and small patios.
descriptionParagraphs: Respira is built from weather-treated materials that shrug off rain and sun, so it can live outside year-round without fading or warping.
The narrow footprint means it tucks into a balcony corner easily, while the bar height keeps it comfortable for standing conversations.

products.name: Grifo
products.description: A soft-glow night lamp with a slim silhouette that fits any bedside table.
descriptionParagraphs: Grifo uses a warm, dimmable bulb designed to wind you down before sleep rather than jolt you awake — no harsh white light here.
The base is weighted so the lamp stays put even on a crowded nightstand, and the cord routes discreetly through the stand itself.

products.name: Muggo
products.description: A small ceramic mug with a wide handle, glazed by hand in small batches.
descriptionParagraphs: Muggo is thrown on a wheel and glazed one at a time, so no two mugs are perfectly identical — small variations in the glaze are part of the charm.
It holds enough coffee to get through your morning routine without weighing your hand down, and it's safe for both the microwave and dishwasher.

products.name: Pinky
products.description: A playful bed set with a soft headboard and matching linens for a kids' room or guest space.
descriptionParagraphs: Pinky pairs a rounded, upholstered headboard with a sturdy slatted base, so it's supportive enough for everyday sleep and soft enough to lean back and read.
The included linens are woven from breathable cotton, made to hold their color through repeated washes.

products.name: Potty
products.description: A minimal accent stool that works as extra seating or a plant stand.
descriptionParagraphs: Potty strips furniture down to the essentials — a single curved form with no visible joints, finished in a matte coat that resists scuffing.
Light enough to move with one hand, it's just as happy holding a potted plant as it is holding a guest for an extra seat.

products.name: Astrid
products.description: A modern lounge chair with a rounded silhouette designed for relaxed reading and quiet evenings.
descriptionParagraphs: Astrid combines a supportive curved back with generous cushioning, creating a comfortable seat for reading or enjoying a cup of coffee.
Its compact footprint makes it easy to place beside a sofa, bookshelf, or bedroom window without overwhelming the room.

products.name: Calista
products.description: A clean-lined coffee table with a warm wooden finish and a softly rounded tabletop.
descriptionParagraphs: Calista is designed around simple proportions, giving you enough surface for coffee, books, and everyday essentials without looking bulky.
The rounded corners add a softer touch while the sturdy wooden legs provide reliable support for daily use.

products.name: Elora
products.description: An elegant dining table with a spacious top and refined natural wood finish.
descriptionParagraphs: Elora provides generous space for family meals, dinner parties, and long conversations around the table.
The solid frame keeps the table stable while the natural finish highlights the character of the wood.

products.name: Nordic
products.description: A Scandinavian-inspired chair with a simple frame and comfortable upholstered seat.
descriptionParagraphs: Nordic uses a lightweight wooden frame and softly padded seat to balance visual simplicity with everyday comfort.
Its neutral design works naturally around dining tables, desks, and small cafe spaces.

products.name: Velora
products.description: A luxurious armchair featuring deep cushioning and a sophisticated rounded frame.
descriptionParagraphs: Velora is built around a generous seat and supportive backrest, making it ideal for extended reading sessions or relaxed conversations.
The textured upholstery adds depth while the rounded silhouette keeps the design inviting and contemporary.

products.name: Luna
products.description: A compact round side table designed for sofas, armchairs, and bedside spaces.
descriptionParagraphs: Luna features a circular tabletop that provides just enough space for a lamp, book, or morning coffee.
Its lightweight construction makes it easy to move between rooms whenever you want to refresh your layout.

products.name: Arco
products.description: A tall floor lamp with an adjustable curved arm for focused ambient lighting.
descriptionParagraphs: Arco directs warm light exactly where you need it, making it useful beside a sofa, reading chair, or workspace.
The weighted base keeps the lamp stable while its slim profile avoids taking up unnecessary floor space.

products.name: Milo
products.description: A compact wooden bookshelf with open shelves for books, plants, and decorative objects.
descriptionParagraphs: Milo keeps everything visible with four open shelves that are easy to organize and access.
Its vertical shape makes smart use of wall space while maintaining a clean and uncluttered appearance.

products.name: Nara
products.description: A rounded decorative mirror that adds light and depth to modern interiors.
descriptionParagraphs: Nara uses a softly curved frame to create a relaxed focal point above a console, dresser, or entryway table.
The generous reflective surface helps brighten smaller rooms while keeping the overall design understated.

products.name: Siena
products.description: A soft three-seat sofa with deep cushions and a relaxed contemporary shape.
descriptionParagraphs: Siena is designed for everyday lounging with supportive cushions that stay comfortable without feeling overly firm.
Its simple silhouette pairs easily with coffee tables, rugs, and accent chairs in both modern and classic interiors.

products.name: Tessa
products.description: A compact bedside cabinet with a drawer for keeping nighttime essentials organized.
descriptionParagraphs: Tessa gives you a convenient surface for a lamp, phone, and favorite book while keeping smaller items hidden in its drawer.
The compact proportions make it suitable for bedrooms where every centimeter of floor space matters.

products.name: Orion
products.description: A clean modern desk with a spacious work surface and slim supporting legs.
descriptionParagraphs: Orion provides enough room for a laptop, monitor, notebooks, and everyday work accessories without feeling oversized.
The simple construction makes it easy to pair with ergonomic office chairs and minimalist home decor.

products.name: Cora
products.description: A handcrafted decorative vase with an organic silhouette and textured finish.
descriptionParagraphs: Cora adds a subtle decorative accent to shelves, dining tables, and entryway consoles.
Its textured surface catches light softly and works beautifully with dried flowers or as a standalone piece.

products.name: Elio
products.description: A minimalist pendant lamp designed to create a warm focal point above tables and counters.
descriptionParagraphs: Elio produces a soft downward glow that works especially well above dining tables, kitchen islands, or small cafe counters.
Its simple shape keeps the fixture visually light while still adding character to the room.

products.name: Faye
products.description: A soft decorative cushion with a textured cover for sofas, beds, and lounge chairs.
descriptionParagraphs: Faye adds an easy layer of comfort without changing the character of your existing furniture.
The removable cover can be cleaned easily and the flexible filling keeps its shape after repeated use.

products.name: Haven
products.description: A weather-resistant outdoor lounge chair made for balconies, patios, and garden corners.
descriptionParagraphs: Haven combines a durable frame with comfortable cushioning designed to handle everyday outdoor use.
Its relaxed angle makes it ideal for reading, enjoying coffee, or spending quiet afternoons outside.

products.name: Riva
products.description: A compact dining bench that provides flexible seating around small dining tables.
descriptionParagraphs: Riva comfortably seats two people while taking up less visual space than individual dining chairs.
The sturdy wooden construction makes it practical for everyday meals while maintaining a warm and natural appearance.

products.name: Mira
products.description: A ceramic table lamp with a soft fabric shade and warm ambient glow.
descriptionParagraphs: Mira creates a gentle pool of light that works well on bedside tables, desks, and living room consoles.
The ceramic base gives the lamp a handcrafted feel while the neutral shade keeps the overall look timeless.

products.name: Nova
products.description: A versatile storage cabinet with clean doors and generous interior space.
descriptionParagraphs: Nova hides everyday clutter behind smooth doors while keeping your room visually clean and organized.
Adjustable interior shelving lets you customize the cabinet for books, tableware, accessories, or household items.

products.name: Sora
products.description: A rounded dining chair with a supportive backrest and soft upholstered seat.
descriptionParagraphs: Sora features a curved back that provides comfortable support while keeping the overall silhouette light and elegant.
Its neutral upholstery works with a wide range of dining tables and interior styles.

products.name: Vera
products.description: A low-profile TV console with concealed storage and a clean modern silhouette.
descriptionParagraphs: Vera keeps entertainment equipment organized with open cable-friendly compartments and closed storage for smaller accessories.
The low profile helps maintain an open visual line across the living room while providing plenty of useful storage.

products.name: Zeno
products.description: A comfortable floor cushion designed for casual seating, meditation, and relaxed gatherings.
descriptionParagraphs: Zeno uses dense cushioning that provides comfortable support while sitting on the floor for extended periods.
Its understated design makes it easy to layer several cushions together around a low table or reading corner.
